cbee05fe7b18fd35e971.en: The past progressive shows an action that was going on in the past. Use was or were with an -ing verb.
cbee05fe7b18fd35e971.id: Past progressive menunjukkan perbuatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu. Pakai was atau were dengan kata kerja -ing.

4ec5f455275925b3741a.en: It is often used when another action interrupts it.
4ec5f455275925b3741a.id: Bentuk ini sering dipakai saat ada perbuatan lain yang menyelanya.

36a8c5ee8327cfbf5251.en: The present perfect uses has or have with a past form. It links the past to now.
36a8c5ee8327cfbf5251.id: Present perfect memakai has atau have dengan bentuk lampau (past form). Bentuk ini menghubungkan masa lalu dengan sekarang.

78c56f8f1b654a7d82ba.en: Some verbs have a special form after has or have.
78c56f8f1b654a7d82ba.id: Ada kata kerja yang punya bentuk khusus setelah has atau have.

2fadded1a5b74e438e8e.en: Use has with he, she or it. Use have with I, you, we and they.
2fadded1a5b74e438e8e.id: Pakai has dengan he, she, atau it. Pakai have dengan I, you, we, dan they.

4186a9df7a0a13d2e300.en: Do not use the present perfect with a finished time like yesterday.
4186a9df7a0a13d2e300.id: Jangan pakai present perfect dengan waktu yang sudah selesai, seperti yesterday.

d8eeaa914f2fbbef3626.en: With we in the past progressive, we use were: we were swimming.
d8eeaa914f2fbbef3626.id: Dengan we dalam past progressive, kita memakai were: we were swimming.

94244af1b8c3f9febe02.en: Ana is one person, like she, so we use has: Ana has finished her drawing.
94244af1b8c3f9febe02.id: Ana adalah satu orang, seperti she, jadi kita memakai has: Ana has finished her drawing.

b840dd1bd7e188d8f2a8.en: With I in the past, we use was: I was reading. The reading was going on when Mum called.
b840dd1bd7e188d8f2a8.id: Dengan I pada masa lampau, kita memakai was: I was reading. Kegiatan membaca sedang berlangsung saat Ibu memanggil.

b954f5bdf935ae973a02.en: With they in the past, we use were: they were playing.
b954f5bdf935ae973a02.id: Dengan they pada masa lampau, kita memakai were: they were playing.

a55658fa7db2a04d47e7.en: The past progressive uses was or were with an -ing verb: Dewi was painting.
a55658fa7db2a04d47e7.id: Past progressive memakai was atau were dengan kata kerja berakhiran -ing: Dewi was painting.

e378f53521bd80b1245e.en: The present perfect is has or have with a past form: we have finished.
e378f53521bd80b1245e.id: Present perfect adalah has atau have dengan bentuk lampau kata kerja: we have finished.

f0726aebed1ea6c3e487.en: Leo is one person, like he, so we use has: Leo has lost his pencil case.
f0726aebed1ea6c3e487.id: Leo adalah satu orang, seperti he, jadi kita memakai has: Leo has lost his pencil case.

093a2e493260e1718727.en: After has or have, these verbs use special past forms: eaten, gone, seen, written and taken.
093a2e493260e1718727.id: Setelah has atau have, kata kerja ini memakai bentuk lampau khusus: eaten, gone, seen, written, dan taken.

36c9592a56a9fe2299b2.en: The form of ride after have is ridden: Have you ever ridden a horse?
36c9592a56a9fe2299b2.id: Bentuk ride setelah have adalah ridden: Have you ever ridden a horse?

f74587d08b39489d1ece.en: Was or were with an -ing verb is the past progressive. Has or have with a past form is the present perfect.
f74587d08b39489d1ece.id: Was atau were dengan kata kerja berakhiran -ing adalah past progressive. Has atau have dengan bentuk lampau adalah present perfect.

3c032eb59fb24b20fab9.en: I was walking home shows an action that was going on. When it started to rain shows what interrupted it.
3c032eb59fb24b20fab9.id: I was walking home menunjukkan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung. When it started to rain menunjukkan hal yang menyelanya.

ca1da97e5b35322cc91f.en: We were watching shows that the film was going on. The lights went out is the sudden action that interrupted it.
ca1da97e5b35322cc91f.id: We were watching menunjukkan bahwa film sedang berlangsung. The lights went out adalah kejadian tiba-tiba yang menyelanya.

bdb9b23d84f811aeed7c.en: With she we use has, and after has we use gone: she has gone to the shop.
bdb9b23d84f811aeed7c.id: Dengan she kita memakai has, dan setelah has kita memakai gone: she has gone to the shop.

5e172bdce3dceb33f3ca.en: Yesterday is a finished time, so we use the simple past: I saw that film yesterday. Without yesterday, we could say I have seen that film.
5e172bdce3dceb33f3ca.id: Yesterday adalah waktu yang sudah selesai, jadi kita memakai simple past: I saw that film yesterday. Tanpa yesterday, kita bisa mengatakan I have seen that film.

3c611509061409d08041.en: My sister is one person, and last night is past, so we say was drawing.
3c611509061409d08041.id: My sister adalah satu orang, dan last night adalah masa lampau, jadi kita mengatakan was drawing.

5bc954c7b2dbf9f084a1.en: Has bought uses the past form of buy: bought.
5bc954c7b2dbf9f084a1.id: Has bought memakai bentuk lampau dari buy: bought.

88015f3d7e6ecc4cc705.en: Sekar and I is more than one, so were. Bayu is one person, so was.
88015f3d7e6ecc4cc705.id: Sekar and I lebih dari satu orang, jadi were. Bayu adalah satu orang, jadi was.

0f347739635ea69ac6d5.en: After has, the form of eat is eaten, not ate.
0f347739635ea69ac6d5.id: Setelah has, bentuk eat adalah eaten, bukan ate.

49eb017a9bb9a0d47685.en: The twins is plural, so we say have finished.
49eb017a9bb9a0d47685.id: The twins berarti lebih dari satu (plural), jadi kita mengatakan have finished.

2258d2f51d223efcd3c8.en: After has or have we use the past participle: taken, broken, written, driven, chosen.
2258d2f51d223efcd3c8.id: Setelah has atau have, kita memakai past participle: taken, broken, written, driven, chosen.

d46734d3a1a96bd134e5.en: Yuki is one person, so has. Write becomes written after has.
d46734d3a1a96bd134e5.id: Yuki adalah satu orang, jadi has. Write menjadi written setelah has.

1c2c69b312fa5fe30269.en: We were walking is the past progressive. It began to rain interrupted it.
1c2c69b312fa5fe30269.id: We were walking adalah past progressive. It began to rain menyelanya.

7ea4b7d621fc42893cc1.en: Builds is present. The story is in the past, so it must be built.
7ea4b7d621fc42893cc1.id: Builds adalah bentuk masa kini (present). Cerita itu terjadi pada masa lampau (past), jadi kata itu harus menjadi built.

2a71b8bf4d47afe03b9a.en: We say has eaten, has seen and has gone, but I ate, I saw and I went.
2a71b8bf4d47afe03b9a.id: Kita mengatakan has eaten, has seen, dan has gone, tetapi I ate, I saw, dan I went.

268bb43fbdfdc0236f58.en: Were playing was in progress when it started to rain.
268bb43fbdfdc0236f58.id: Were playing sedang berlangsung saat it started to rain.

19f31a3cb5f31e815964.en: Dewi was watering shows the action was in progress when her brother interrupted.
19f31a3cb5f31e815964.id: Dewi was watering menunjukkan kegiatan itu sedang berlangsung saat adiknya menyela.

58cc5c6ec4d7fd226c40.en: Leo walked to the lake. While he was walking, he saw a duck.
58cc5c6ec4d7fd226c40.id: Leo walked to the lake. While he was walking, he saw a duck.

f81baa764615f2990854.en: Has been means he went and came back. Has gone means he has not come back yet.
f81baa764615f2990854.id: Has been berarti ia pergi dan sudah kembali. Has gone berarti ia belum kembali.

c9f9fe86cf180e6a52d4.en: The story is in the simple past. Has shown does not fit, so it should be showed her a gold coin.
c9f9fe86cf180e6a52d4.id: Cerita itu memakai simple past. Has shown tidak cocok, jadi seharusnya showed her a gold coin.

662d1df2c0cde2e62d48.en: Has lived tells us it began in the past and is still true now.
662d1df2c0cde2e62d48.id: Has lived memberi tahu kita bahwa hal itu dimulai pada masa lampau dan masih benar sampai sekarang.

3801d295f39b80b6a2f4.en: The past progressive uses was or were with an -ing verb to show an action in progress in the past: was reading.
3801d295f39b80b6a2f4.id: Past progressive memakai was atau were dengan kata kerja berakhiran -ing untuk menunjukkan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada masa lampau: was reading.

194bc43cdd1aa195dab0.en: Are playing is the present progressive. The past progressive needs was or were, as in they were playing.
194bc43cdd1aa195dab0.id: Are playing adalah present progressive. Past progressive memerlukan was atau were, seperti they were playing.

18dac854fee3c2c7bc3c.en: The present perfect uses has or have with a past form of the verb. Has finished links the past to now.
18dac854fee3c2c7bc3c.id: Present perfect memakai has atau have dengan bentuk lampau kata kerja. Has finished menghubungkan masa lampau dengan sekarang.

7c43a4889a2dd276907a.en: With he, she or it we use has, so the correct sentence is He has eaten his lunch.
7c43a4889a2dd276907a.id: Dengan he, she, atau it kita memakai has, jadi kalimat yang benar adalah He has eaten his lunch.

e6f0f7c9fd4ce45e0429.en: With we we use were, so the correct sentence is We were walking to school.
e6f0f7c9fd4ce45e0429.id: Dengan we kita memakai were, jadi kalimat yang benar adalah We were walking to school.

093d9c24a9291a323ab5.en: Has or have plus a past form gives the present perfect, for example they have gone.
093d9c24a9291a323ab5.id: Has atau have ditambah bentuk lampau menghasilkan present perfect, misalnya they have gone.

a156786505d568507e90.en: With she, we use has: she has finished.
a156786505d568507e90.id: Dengan she, kita memakai has: she has finished.

cb8b824c792dbd094b8c.en: With I we use was: I was reading.
cb8b824c792dbd094b8c.id: Dengan I kita memakai was: I was reading.
